podcast.title: CrimeTimeSnacks • A True Crime Podcast
podcast.subtitle: Exploring unsolved cases, murders, and mysteries.
podcast.description: Crime Time Snacks is a true crime podcast that delves into a variety of unsolved cases, exploring the facts, theories, and evidence surrounding each mystery. The podcast aims to provide listeners with a comprehensive understanding of these cases, encouraging them to engage with the content and form their own conclusions.
podcast.author: Cory

episodes.title: The Miami Apartment Stabbing
episodes.description: Courtney Clenney was arrested on August 10, 2022. She pleaded guilty on August 10, 2026. Four years, to the day, and the case still did not answer its own question. Hey everyone, it's Cory. This time on CrimeTimeSnacks: the killing of Christian Obumseli in a Miami high-rise. The fourteen minutes on April 3, 2022, the elevator video, the medical examiner's finding that broke the self-defense account, the four months before an arrest, the battered spouse defense that never reached a jury, and what a plea leaves unsettled. If any of this sounds like your life, the National Domestic Violence Hotline is 800-799-7233.

episodes.title: JonBenet Ramsey: Thirty Years
episodes.description: Thirty years on, two investigations are still running: Boulder police, and a volunteer team working from the spreadsheet a dead detective left behind. Hey everyone, it's Cory. This time on CrimeTimeSnacks: what the record in the JonBenet Ramsey case actually shows at thirty years. The morning the scene was lost, the ransom note two courts read two ways, the grand jury vote that stayed secret for fourteen years, the unknown male DNA, and where both investigations stand now. No one has ever been charged.

episodes.title: Gilgo Beach: Eight Names
episodes.description: In April 2026, Rex Heuermann was asked how he killed eight women. He gave the same one-word answer each time. Hey everyone, it's Cory. This time on CrimeTimeSnacks: the Gilgo Beach murders from the 911 call that started the search to the guilty plea that ended it. Who the women were, why the case stalled for a decade, the truck and the pizza crust that broke it, and what is still unanswered: Shannan Gilbert, the victim known as Asian Doe, and a mother and daughter whose case turned out to be something else.

episodes.title: Murders in Moscow: The Plea
episodes.description:
Welcome back to CrimeTimeSnacks, I'm your host Cory. Today we are returning to Moscow, Idaho, to look at the legal aftermath of a tragedy that shook the nation. If you haven't heard our previous coverage of the devastating loss of Ethan, Madison, Xana, and Kaylee, you might want to start there. This time, we are focusing entirely on what happened after the arrest of Bryan Kohberger.

We will walk through the grueling pre-trial motions, the intense battles over DNA and cell-site evidence, and the sudden pivot to a plea agreement in the summer of 2025. It is a complex look at the justice system, the weight of capital punishment, and the legal maneuvering that followed the initial shock of the crimes.

episodes.title: The Menendez Brothers: The Parole Years
episodes.description:
Hey everyone, it's Cory. This time on CrimeTimeSnacks: what happened to Lyle and Erik Menendez after the verdict. Thirty years of appeals that went nowhere, the marriages inside prison walls, the TikTok generation that heard the abuse testimony differently, a letter found in a dresser, and a former Menudo member who came forward in 2023.

Then the part that is still moving: one district attorney who asked for resentencing and another who called their defense self-serving lies, the May 2025 ruling that cut their sentences to fifty years to life, the parole board that said no three months later, the judge who refused a new trial, and the early parole hearing now set for March 2027.

I covered the murders and the trials in an earlier episode, so this one tells 1989 once and spends its time on everything since.

episodes.title: Delphi: The Appeal
episodes.description: Three judges, thirty minutes a side. On September 21, 2026, the Indiana Court of Appeals hears Richard Allen's challenge to his conviction for the murders of Abby Williams and Libby German. Hey everyone, it's Cory. This time on CrimeTimeSnacks: everything that has happened in the Delphi case since my 2022 episode. The misfiled tip, the arrest, the confessions from a prison cell, the trial, the 130-year sentence, and the three questions now in front of the appeals court, with the state's answer to each. He is convicted and he is appealing. Both of those are true.

episodes.title: The Interrogation of Chris Watts
episodes.description: Hey everyone, it's Cory. This time on CrimeTimeSnacks: the forty-eight hours in which Chris Watts's story came apart on camera. A friend who would not leave a doorstep, a patrol officer who noticed a husband was too calm, a neighbor's security camera, an FBI agent who held back his best evidence, a polygraph score of negative 18, and the way out that investigators offered him. Where the published accounts disagree, I say so. From the welfare check on August 13, 2018 to the oil site at 11 that night two days later, then the plea, the sentence, and the versions of the story he has told since.

episodes.title: The Disappearance of Gabby Petito
episodes.description:
Hey everyone, Cory here. This week on CrimeTimeSnacks, we are looking at a case that completely consumed the internet in the summer of 2021. Gabby Petito and her fiancé Brian Laundrie set out on a four-month van-life journey across the United States. They documented their travels on YouTube and Instagram, painting a picture of the perfect bohemian adventure among the national parks.

But the reality behind the camera was much darker. When Brian returned to his parents' home in Florida without Gabby, and then refused to speak to anyone about where she was, alarm bells rang nationwide. We are going to walk through their timeline, dive into the infamous Moab body-cam footage, and look at how this case changed the way police handle domestic disturbance calls.

episodes.title: Hunting the Golden State Killer
episodes.description:
For more than forty years, California was haunted by an elusive predator known across decades by different names: the Visalia Ransacker, the East Area Rapist, the Original Night Stalker, and ultimately, the Golden State Killer. Leaving behind dozens of violated homes, traumatized survivors, and shattered families, the attacker seemed to vanish into thin air by the mid-1980s, evading traditional police work and fingerprint databases alike.

In this episode, I walk you through how a predator who once wore a police badge managed to operate in the shadows, and how investigators revolutionized criminal forensics by using genetic genealogy to crack open the coldest trail in California history. We examine the timeline, the evidence, and the long road to unmasking an ordinary retiree living in a quiet suburban neighborhood.

episodes.title: Murders in Moscow
episodes.description: In this gripping episode of Crime Time Snacks , we delve into the harrowing case of the Idaho student murders that rocked the nation. On November 13, 2022, four University of Idaho students — Ethan Chapin, Madison Mogen, Xana Kernodle, and Kaylee Goncalves — were tragically murdered in their off-campus rental home in Moscow, Idaho. This episode unpacks the chilling events, the ongoing investigation, and the complexities surrounding the case.

episodes.title: Watts Family Murders
episodes.description: The Watts family murders occurred in August 2018 in Frederick, Colorado. Chris Watts, the father, killed his pregnant wife, Shanann, and their two young daughters, Bella and Celeste. The crime gained significant media attention due to its horrific nature and the subsequent investigation. Watts initially denied involvement but later confessed to the murders. He was sentenced to life in prison without the possibility of parole. The case continues to be a source of fascination and discussion for true crime enthusiasts.

episodes.title: ERIK AND LYLE: The Menendez Brothers
episodes.description: The Menendez brothers, Lyle and Erik, have been in prison for over 35 years. They were convicted in 1996 for the 1989 murders of their parents and sentenced to life in prison without the possibility of parole. This is their story.

episodes.title: JonBenét Ramsey | The Facts 96-22 |Part 1
episodes.description: JonBenét Patricia Ramsey was murdered. That is the only certain thing about this case after 26 years. There is key evidence in this case, as well as more theories than there are people involved. I took weeks of research and broke it down into a two-part segment where I go over all the facts known in the case today, as well as some key suspects. I try to stay away from the theories that have little to no factual basis. Listen to the facts of the case and form your own opinion. Visit CrimeTimeSnacks.com to stay even more involved and join an ever-growing true crime community. -@CrimeTimeSnacks

episodes.title: JonBenét Ramsey Americas Child Beauty Queen
episodes.description: In Boulder, Colorado, just a day after Christmas in 1996, JonBenét Ramsey, a six-year-old child pageant star, was found dead in her basement. She had been beaten and strangled. That was hours after her parents, John and Patsy, reported her missing, and hours after her mom found a ransom note on a staircase in the house. Nobody has ever been convicted in this case, even 26 years later. This is the lead-in to a two-part special where we go back to Christmas 1996 and look again at all the facts in this case.

episodes.title: CrimeTimeSnacks: The Delphi Murder Case 2017
episodes.description: On February 14, 2017, the bodies of Abigail Williams (June 23, 2003 – February 13, 2017) and Liberty German (December 27, 2002 – February 13, 2017) were discovered near the Monon High Bridge Trail. The case has had no prominent suspects until recently. On October 28th police announced they had made an arrest in the case. A 50 year old Delphi Resident was arrested and charged with two felony counts of murder. Listen while we dive into the case starting over 5 years ago in on a beautiful hiking trail.
